content.title: HoverGo Pro Wireless Earbuds, Active Noise Cancelling Bluetooth 5.3 Earphones with 30H Playtime, IPX5 Waterproof for Commute and Workout

bullets.heading: ACTIVE NOISE CANCELLING
bullets.text: Cuts down background noise on the train, in the office, or on a busy street so you can focus on your music and calls.

bullets.heading: UP TO 30 HOURS OF PLAYTIME
bullets.text: The charging case extends total battery life to about 30 hours, so a full week of commuting needs far fewer charges.

bullets.heading: STABLE BLUETOOTH 5.3
bullets.text: Bluetooth 5.3 keeps a steady wireless connection with your phone and other paired devices.

bullets.heading: IPX5 WATER RESISTANT
bullets.text: Rated IPX5 to handle sweat and light rain during runs and gym sessions.

bullets.heading: BUILT FOR EVERYDAY WEAR
bullets.text: A lightweight wireless design made for commuting, working out, and everything in between.

content.description: HoverGo Pro pairs active noise cancelling with a long-lasting charging case, Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, and IPX5 water resistance, making it a practical everyday choice for commuters and active users.

attributes.name: Battery life
attributes.value: Up to 30 hours with charging case

qa.question: Do these earbuds have noise cancelling?
qa.answer: Yes, they feature active noise cancelling.

qa.question: How long does the battery last?
qa.answer: Up to about 30 hours in total when using the charging case.

qa.question: Are they sweat resistant?
qa.answer: They are rated IPX5 for water resistance.
